About Us

At Tringks and Rings we put you first. Our suppliers, customers, clients, smiths and manufacturers. They all mean the world to us. We care about the products that we put out to the world wearers. And as we care about the impact we have as a company. We thoroughly examine our product lifecyle from raw materials to delivery. Improving the quality, longevity and asthetic of our products. While always considering and focusing on keeping the world we live in, in such a beautiful state.


It isn't all just materials and environment. The steps we take ensure that we provide optimum goods. Quality whilst providing our customers with consistent and personal bespoke service. If there is any querry you may have. Please do, feel free reach out to us.

From Jamal and the Team at Tringks and Rings.
